messages:
acme_ops: Hey team — after last night's authz rollout our private VPC tenant 'tenant-512' shows zero ingestion on the console for the 02:00-03:00 UTC window. Other tenants look fine. Can you check?

elaine.su: Sorry you're hitting this — checking now. Which private cluster and dashboard URL?

acme_ops: cluster: prod-eu-vpc-3, dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/private/metrics?tenant=tenant-512

tariq.khan: quick check: are requests hitting the ingest endpoint or being rejected at the edge? can you share a sample request id from that window?

acme_ops: I grabbed a few request IDs: req_20270301_0205_aa, req_20270301_0212_bb. Curling the private endpoint from our jump host shows 403 when we include X-Tenant header. Without it we get 401.

kevin.r: interesting — edge logs show 403 with message: "tenant lookup failed: no tenant claim". past deploy note: authz rollout rotated signing keys and changed claim mapping from 'tenant_id' -> 'tenant' for JWT. maybe some sidecars still expect the old claim.

elaine.su: can you paste the curl you ran? also include raw JWT (masked) if possible.

acme_ops: curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted-jwt>" -H "X-Tenant: tenant-512" https://ingest.prod-eu.internal/redwood/ingest -> 403

ops-bot: deploy #authz-v2 completed 2027-03-01T01:45:12Z on prod-eu-vpc-*. Canary 3/3 :white_check_mark:

tariq.khan: I'm seeing in the auth-proxy logs: "WARN claim 'tenant_id' not found; trying alias 'tenant'" then later "ERROR tenant resolved to '' - rejecting". Looks like a race where some caches still hold old public key thumbprint and signature verification fails for tokens minted after rotation. That causes claim parsing to be empty and routing to skip tenant mapping.

kevin.r: reproducer: on our side, creating a token signed with new key and request shows 403 until we restart auth-proxy pod -> then it accepts. So pods with old key material don't validate new tokens.

elaine.su: action plan: 1) rotate auth-proxy pods gracefully (rolling restart) to pick up new JWKS, 2) temporarily accept both 'tenant_id' and 'tenant' claims via mapping fallback, 3) run ingest backfill for missing window and mark dashboard cache flush. I'll coordinate with infra.

tariq.khan: started rolling restart of auth-proxy statefulset (prod-eu-vpc-3). commands: kubectl rollout restart sts/auth-proxy -n redwood-prod-eu-vpc-3. monitoring pods coming back now.

ingest-bot: ingest pipeline alert: private.ingest.lag spike 120s -> resolving after consumer restart

kevin.r: after restart confirmed auth-proxy now validates new tokens. I pushed a short-term mapping patch to accept both claim keys (pr #3942) and hot-reloaded config.

acme_ops: re-ran same curl and gets 202 Accepted now. Dashboard shows partial backfill metrics appearing for tenant-512 (about 70% of missing rows). :thumbsup:

elaine.su: I'll trigger a metrics backfill job to fill the remaining 30% and flush dashboard cache. backfill job id: backfill-20270301-tenant-512. ETA ~10min.

ops-bot: backfill job backfill-20270301-tenant-512 started by elaine.su

acme_ops: thanks all — will keep monitoring. noticed spikes in token errors right at 01:45 when the key rotated.

tariq.khan: root cause summary: JWKS rotation caused a short window where pods had mixed key material -> tokens minted with new key couldn't be validated -> auth-proxy returned 403 and tenant claim was not extracted -> routing to tenant-specific ingest failed -> metrics were not ingested for that tenant for ~12-20 minutes. Fix: ensure zero-downtime JWKS rollout (key preload + dual-key acceptance) and mapping fallback.

elaine.su: follow-ups: add monitoring alert for claim-extraction-failures, add migration doc for JWKS rotation, and schedule a patch to make claim aliasing permanent. Resolving this thread when backfill completes. :eyes:

ingest-bot: backfill job completed, wrote 00:12:34, rows backfilled: 42,312

acme_ops: metrics all present now. thanks everyone!"
